name: 大唐双龙传（LLMUD）
english_name: Twin Dragons of the Tang Dynasty (LLMUD)
english_description: LLMUD v0.11, adapted from Huang Yi's novel "Twin Dragons of the Tang Dynasty" -- and, per a file-level check, running essentially the SAME 大唐双龙 authored game world as siblings dtsl/dtsl2: ~99% of its ~5,100-file domain tree is byte-identical to dtsl's, with only the newbie academy and 石龙武馆 hub area rewritten from scratch for this build (everything past it wasn't). Set at the fall of the Sui dynasty and the rise of Tang; four core attributes (膂力/悟性/根骨/身法) are assigned once at registration (must sum to 80, 10-30 each), and wizards/admins carry the in-game title 天帝 ("Heavenly Emperor") instead of the siblings' plain (admin) tag. Live-verified content beyond the shared world map: a gender-gated, women-only sect (花间派, reachable in 洛阳 via 候希白) that correctly refuses a male apprentice, a 海沙帮-style gang-leadership system where headship literally changes hands to whoever defeats the incumbent in real combat, and a full kill-to-death-to-revival loop through 扬州's real outdoor wilderness ending at 阎罗殿's ghost dialogue. A driver-crashing 2-argument `tell_room()` bug shared with dtsl/dtsl2 was independently confirmed here too and its fix ported over; see NOTES.md.
